goal: Establish the multi-tenant store boundary so that every downstream entity (Product, Order, Invoice) is correctly scoped and no data leaks between stores.
goal_metric: All queries for products/orders/invoices return only records belonging to the caller's storeId. Cross-store query attempts return 403.

actors.name: System Admin (Quản trị hệ thống)
actors.role_description: Registers new retail locations in the system.
actors.impact: Can create a store with a valid Vietnamese tax code and assign users to it. Can deactivate a store when it closes.

actors.name: Store Manager (Quản lý cửa hàng)
actors.role_description: Needs to verify and present the store's registered details (name, tax code, address) on printed receipts and invoices.
actors.impact: Can view their own store's full details via a single GET endpoint.

out_of_scope: Multiple addresses per store (not required by current regulations)
